name: 12287-sharegpt-1b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=400 and all 400 start at once, bounded at 6000 requests / 900 s safety, first 25% discarded as warmup by completion.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix buckets: prompt ~225 tokens (stdev 244, 4..1024), output ~202 tokens (stdev 209, 4..1024). Lengths are drawn as Gaussians clamped into [min, max], so the mean and spread are ShareGPT's but the skew is not; output lengths are forced (the backend sets ignore_eos whenever max_tokens is set) and `request_format: plain` puts the raw prompt string on the wire with no template tokens added.
purpose: A general-purpose chat assistant serving 400 concurrent users short single-turn prompts on one small-model GPU.
launch:
model: unsloth/Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct
tensor-parallel-size: 1
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
enable-prefix-caching: false
disable-log-requests: true
max-num-seqs: 1024
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
dtype: bfloat16
max-model-len: 4096
